title: How $600 Became $8,400
description:
A car repair costs $600. Eighteen months later the debt is $3,100, the car is gone, and paying the minimum will cost $8,400 before it clears. This is the story of how that happens, one reasonable decision at a time.

She is not a real person. The character is a composite, but the mechanics are exact: the minimum payment is one percent of the balance plus interest, so it falls as the balance falls. At 24.99% APR a $3,100 balance takes 189 months to clear and costs $5,321 in interest.

If you are in this, the numbers are not a judgement. Nobody in this story made an obviously wrong choice, which is the part worth understanding.
